rationale: AEIS needed a frozen autoscaler simulation that verifies CPU, queue depth and error-rate reactions, scale-up/down paths and anti-flapping cooldown behavior. Existing autoscaler routes exposed evaluation/execution but did not prove the full production-readiness scenario.

steps: Remove AutoscalerSignal, AutoscalerSimulationProfile and AutoscalerSimulationRunner from sylion.worker.autoscaler.
Run autoscaler, worker routes and worker lifecycle tests twice.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that autoscaler simulation observes scale-up and scale-down decisions, blocks rapid opposite actions during cooldown and records Evidence Spine output.
pre_conditions: EvidenceSpine can register inline JSON artifacts.
steps: Run compileall for autoscaler and autoscaler routes.
Run simulation unit tests for default profile and cooldown/no-flapping profile.
Run worker route and worker lifecycle regressions.
Run no-mock scan and git diff whitespace check.
Repeat the same verification scope as PASS2.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: Autoscaler simulation passes only when scale-up, scale-down, cooldown and no-flapping checks all pass and evidence is recorded.
